packageRules.description: A closed PR skips the version its title names. The default major title names only the major (`to v5`), so closing it would skip every later v5 release.

customManagers.description: Renovate's Swift manager reads only Package.swift, and an Xcode project stores its resolved packages here. One match edits revision and version together; the name comes from the URL, so any GitHub-hosted package matches.
A major move fails `upToNextMajorVersion` unless minimumVersion moves with it. The same depName as in Package.resolved puts both edits in one PR.
Each table in tools.toml is a tool downloaded from a GitHub release; maintenance/tools/install-tools.sh builds the download URL from repo and version, so the version is the release tag.
